thesis: A net-cash games franchise with operating margin at a 2-year high of 36.6% and a 41.7% FCF margin trades below its own 5-year minimum on every multiple, pricing a revenue decline its margins and cash generation do not show.
reason: The post-results fall is an overreaction to a revenue miss that left margins, cash conversion and net cash intact; the scorecard clears the buy threshold. ADD toward the conviction-4 size as Python sizes it; the China/HK country cap and the cash floor limit how much can actually be added.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below the FY2024 level of 28.1%, reversing the five-year expansion.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2024 level of 36.5%, signalling cash generation is no longer keeping pace.
TTM gross margin falls below the FY2024 level of 62.5%, indicating game-portfolio mix or monetization is deteriorating.
A new PRC regulation materially restricts game monetization, or a VIE-related regulatory action forces deconsolidation, as disclosed in a company filing or release.
